# hpe_morpheus_monitoring_contact (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Monitoring Contact resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_monitoring_contact" "example" {
  name          = "Ops Team"
  email_address = "ops-team@example.com"
  sms_address   = "+15551234567"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the monitoring contact.

### Optional

- `email_address` (String) Email notification address.
- `slack_hook` (String) Slack webhook URL.
- `sms_address` (String) SMS notification address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the monitoring contact.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_monitoring_contact.example 123
```
